U0001.instruccion: Que se vea de perfil tipo mostrando los resultado del volúmen en glúteos piernas y caderas
U0001.instruccion_en: Change only the woman's pose: she now stands in side profile (about 80 degrees), one hand on her waist, head turned to the camera with the same happy surprised face, framed from head to knees so her fuller silhouette in the same blue jeans reads naturally along hips and legs. Same woman, same white crop tee and blue jeans, same park background, same zone and size. Keep every text, the bottle, the hand, the badge, the arrow, the drop icon, the comment box, fonts and colors exactly as they are. Not from behind, no close-up or crop on any body part, no exaggerated arched pose.
U0001.resumen: La modelo ahora sale de perfil, de la cabeza a las rodillas, para que se note la silueta en caderas y piernas. Lo demás queda igual. No la pusimos de espaldas ni con la toma centrada en los glúteos, porque Meta suele rechazar esas imágenes.

U0002.instruccion: Que se vea más la progresión, cada cuadro debe ser vestimenta, pose, peinado, escenario, etc diferente, se debe ver visualmente la progresión, el primer cuadro más delgadad de piernas, caderas y gluteos más planos
U0002.instruccion_en: Redo only the 4 day panels with the same woman (same face, slim build) and a clear, visible progression; every panel must have a different outfit, pose, hairstyle and setting. Day 1: thin straight legs, narrow flat hips, flat silhouette with no curve; loose light-blue mom jeans hanging flat, one hand pulling the waistband a fist away from her body to show the gap, oversized grey t-shirt, messy low bun, bedroom with mirror, cool dim light, frustrated look. Day 7: slightly more shaped; black straight trousers, white t-shirt, high ponytail, kitchen, warm daylight. Day 14: noticeably more shaped; dark fitted jeans, striped knit top, half-up hair, sunny balcony with plants, light smile. Day 21: the most shaped and defined silhouette, still natural; terracotta wrap midi dress, loose defined curls, bright living room, confident smile. Front or three-quarter front views, knees-up framing, never from behind, no close-up on body zones. Keep unchanged: headline, day labels, panel grid and borders, product, offer box, logo, palette and fonts.
U0002.resumen: Cada día ahora tiene otra ropa, pose, peinado y lugar. El día 1 muestra piernas delgadas y caderas planas, y el cambio crece hasta el día 21.
